== 70% ==
What time of year can go before CHICKEN, ONION and CLEANING?

'''SPRING''' CHICKEN, '''SPRING''' ONION and '''SPRING''' CLEANING

== 60% ==
{| class="fandom-table"
! colspan="3" |Which of the following words only contains letters which appear more than once?
|-
|N'''O'''NSENSE
|'''MURMUR'''
|END'''A'''N'''G'''E'''R'''ED
|}
There is only one O in NONSENSE and just one A, G and R in ENDANGERED.

== 25% ==
I’m putting a line through some words.

<s>DICE</s>   <s>CHICK</s>   <s>OXIDE</s>
{| class="fandom-table"
! colspan="5" |On reflection, which one of these words should I also put a line through?
|-
|<s>FIX</s>
|<s>HIKER</s>
|<s>'''BOXED'''</s>
|<s>MILK</s>
|<s>LEDGE</s>
|}
BOXED is the only other word in which everything below the line is a reflection of everything above.

== 20% ==
You are a zookeeper and it’s weigh-in day at the zoo. How many lions weigh the same as six rhinos?

[[File:Rhino.png|frameless]]

If 3 rhinos = 2 hippos and 4 lions = 2 hippos, then 6 rhinos = 8 lions.

== 15% ==
Which two words, that contain the same five letters as each other but in a different order, mean the same as the two words below?

FAIRLY SILENT

'''QUITE QUIET''': FAIRLY = QUITE and SILENT = QUIET.

== 5% ==
On this clock, the hour hand is past the five and the minute hand is pointing at the six. On a normal clock, those hands pointing at those numbers would mean it’s half past five. Assuming the hands move round this clockface normally, what time will be indicated by the numbers the hands point to in 30 minutes on this clock?

[[File:Clock4.png|frameless]]

If the hour hand is on 10 and the minute hand is on 12, then the time is 10 o’clock.

== 1% ==
What new word links the capitalised words below?

My SON TED ate raw FOOD and got SICK, then went to BED with me by his SIDE.

The word SEA can be put in front of each of the capitalised words to make new words – '''SEA'''SON, '''SEA'''TED, '''SEA'''FOOD, '''SEA'''SICK, '''SEA'''BED and '''SEA'''SIDE.
